data.exact_reserve_text:
The estimate for claims at the beginning of the year as compared with net payments and provisions at the end of the year in respect of prior years' claims are as follows:

Favourable movement in technical provisions 56.4 37.3
The movement in estimate of the prior year is driven mainly by favourable loss experience and incurred claims forms a 10% (2020: 7%) component of the 2021 loss ratio of 46% (2020: 53%).
data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate reported a net favourable prior-year reserve movement of GBP 56.4m (a release), driven mainly by favourable claims experience. This release reduced prior-year claim provisions by approximately 6.8% of the opening gross claims outstanding. The favourable development was concentrated in property and marine/aviation lines, partially offset by adverse movement in third party liability and miscellaneous lines.
raw_causal_phrases: The movement in estimate of the prior year is driven mainly by favourable loss experience
incurred claims forms a 10% (2020: 7%) component of the 2021 loss ratio of 46% (2020: 53%)

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development figure used is the NET favourable movement of GBP 56.4m disclosed in Note 6 (no explicit gross prior-year movement figure was provided). A gross claims development triangle is present in the notes and could be used as an alternative source, but for clarity the explicitly-stated net prior-year movement was used as the primary figure and flagged here. Mapping of the statutory class 'Miscellaneous' to a standard Lloyd's LOB ('Professional Lines') is approximate and therefore lower confidence assigned. Opening reserves taken from the balance sheet prior-year comparative (gross claims outstanding).
